title: taming ai for the little prince: a comparative analysis of nmts and llms in hungarian translation
core_idea: Compare neural machine translation systems (NMTs) and large language models (LLMs) in translating The Little Prince into Hungarian to examine their behaviors, challenges, and approaches to controlling or 'taming' AI outputs for literary translation.
tldr: A comparative study investigating how NMTs and LLMs handle Hungarian translation of The Little Prince, focusing on their differences and the challenge of managing AI-generated literary translations.
